method.angular_flip: Discard commands with |w| < 0.05 rad/s; count sign changes of remaining commands, including across zero interruption. Therefore this is actual nonzero direction reversal, distinct from zero pulses.
method.zero_run: Consecutive cmd_vel messages with both |v| and |w| < 1e-9. Duration until next nonzero command. Does not infer actuator hold between messages. Nearest-status labels in zero_runs are approximate, not exact matching.
method.odom: Quaternion yaw unwrapped using shortest adjacent difference; raw total variation includes measurement noise and is not a filtered physical turn estimate.
method.heading_observability: mppi/status carries phase and scale but no desired yaw or terminal controller submode in this recording; policy switching cannot be directly proved from these topic fields.

notes: finish flag is a software event and does not validate smooth or usable navigation.
Mapping freshness rejection explains many zero interruptions, but cannot alone explain the observed alternating nonzero saturated angular commands.
Frozen phase plus alternating successful commands is directly supported; the underlying yaw-target branch requires code/extra telemetry verification.
